digest.component_or_area: live-DC readiness and Jira DC test harness
propositions: The readiness gate polls only /rest/api/2/serverInfo until 200 and never verifies that required GreenHopper custom fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) are registered

A system-only field inventory with zero customfield entries is declared ready one second after serverInfo goes green, then _assert_project_capabilities fails and misattributes the missing fields to an image degrade rather than timing
The harness readiness check and the probe workflow readiness check use different predicates (serverInfo vs field inventory) causing them to drift and create false negatives or masked failures
The wait gate has no bounded budget, self-diagnosing message, or distinction between 'not registered yet' and 'does not offer by this image', making flakes expensive to debug
A stale/system-only field inventory response must be treated as NOT-READY in the readiness predicate, never as a degraded image, and this property must be asserted by a test to prevent latent flakes
